note: P4328 (Pro 28:18) — who walks in integrity is delivered; who is crooked in his ways suddenly falls.

dims.v: wholeness — the blameless walk that is delivered
the integrity in which a man walks and by which he is delivered — the whole, honest life that stands and is saved, against the crookedness that suddenly falls
the crookedness it is set against (266597)
set against the crooked ways that end in sudden fall
tamim (blameless/whole) — 'whoever walks in INTEGRITY will be delivered'; the whole-hearted, honest walk is safe and saved. Integrity is deliverance; crookedness is ruin (cf 28:6; 10:9).
duplicity — the crooked ways that end in sudden fall
the crookedness of a man's ways that brings him to a sudden fall — the duplicity and double-dealing that, unlike integrity, collapses without warning
the integrity it is set against (266595)
set against the blameless walk that is delivered

iqqesh (crooked/perverse) — 'but he who is CROOKED in his ways will suddenly fall'; duplicity brings sudden ruin. Emergent: the crooked way that seems to prosper, then collapses all at once (cf 28:18a).
